title: The Pink Leopard 2027 Vision Board Night
description: A pink leopard New Year vision board night from Amazon: a pink leopard 2027 planner, a 2027 vision board clip art book, a pink scalloped felt pin board, pink gel pens, a leopard pink mug and a pink light box.
intro: Every January I swear I'm making a vision board. Every January it turns into me cutting out one palm tree and calling it a night. Not this year. This year I set up the whole thing at the kitchen island in December, so the goals are on the wall before the confetti's even swept up. Pink leopard planner, a clip art book so I don't have to hunt through old magazines, a scalloped pin board, and a light box that says HELLO 2027 like it means it. Cute goals hit different.

sections.heading: The planning part
paragraphs: A pink leopard 2027 planner with weekly and monthly pages, page tabs, an inner pocket and an elastic band (6.25 x 8.5 in). It comes with a matching TODAY bookmark, which is the most motivating thing I own.

sections.heading: The vision board part
paragraphs: The BRIGHTENKIDZ 2027 Vision Board Supplies Book is full of pictures, words and quotes to cut out, so no more digging through magazines from 2019. Everything gets pinned on a pink scalloped felt board (24 x 18 in) that's pretty enough to hang where you'll actually see it.

sections.heading: The cozy part
paragraphs: Pink WRITECH gel pens and highlighters for writing the goals down, a leopard pink insulated mug so the coffee stays hot through all the cutting, and a pink light box with 312 letters for your word of the year. A little sparkle, a lot of motivation.
